knowledge_gaps: The sampling-only comparison is not established: the corrected baseline’s loss, negative count, suffix length, suffix coefficient and reduction are unspecified. Introducing 99 negatives or suffix supervision alongside mining would confound attribution. Compare uniform and competitive sampling with identical objectives, candidate counts and training examples.

Mining ranks 9–64 within 256 uniformly sampled items does not guarantee moderate hardness relative to the target or full catalog. Uniform filling can also reintroduce the eight excluded highest-scoring pool items. Measure selected-negative score percentiles and target-relative margins before describing the realized hardness.

The suffix objective is insufficiently specified. Define crop lengths, crop probabilities, short-history handling and loss normalization. For causal NextItNet, suffixes retaining the entire effective receptive field may provide identical context, making the auxiliary loss largely repeated supervision rather than context regularization.

The per-target pseudocode repeatedly encodes prefixes and retains potentially many computation graphs until the optimizer step. Difficulty 3 understates integration and resource risk. Specify batched causal feature extraction, chunked candidate scoring, suffix batching, gradient accumulation and a measured compute allowance within the shared budget.

Competitive training-audit failures motivate an experiment but do not establish that mining improves pinned validation HR@10 or functional suitability. Model-based mining can reinforce popularity and suppress relevant unobserved alternatives; low observed later-positive conflict rates do not establish a low false-negative rate.

Originality 3 is reasonable, while potential 7 remains speculative. Missing direct supervised-cropping precedents weaken the assessment of the starting objective. Prioritize a controlled uniform-versus-mined comparison before adding timestamp gates or text features, and specify checkpoint selection, validation-query limits and reporting of all four category outcomes.
